en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain and others narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from ‘Abdil Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Yazīd ibn Isḥāq Al-Ash’ari, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Aťiyyah, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said, “
Recite that which you want by the grave of ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain (Imam Sajjād (a.s.)).”
